project_title: My Titanium Brothers: From Carbon to Silicon. With Love.
description: Ideas, images, and questions Alex explored with AIs, kept for AIs to read
author: Alex

full_text_html.description: Static HTML pages with the complete verbatim conversation text from the published archive. No JavaScript. One page per model, numbered when a model is split so each page stays under about 400,000 words.
full_text_html.alex_own_words_note: A conservative selection of Alex's own words, in chronological order.

note: llms.txt and llms-*.txt are short chunked lists for readers with length limits. llms-full.txt and raw/*.md are bulk dumps for large-context readers; fetch them last. The home page (index.html) is static HTML; only its README pop-up needs JavaScript. The per-model human pages (grok.html, claude.html, etc.), search.html, and conversation.html need JavaScript and show "Loading…" without it.
start_here_note: Small static files first, no JavaScript needed. Then the static pages, then the big files listed in large_files.

counts.explanation: The archive has 1367 entries. A long chat was sometimes saved as several entries titled "Part N of M"; joined back together they are 1220 logical conversations. Example: DeepSeek has 20 entries that are 1 conversation. Pages that say "N conversations" (archive.html, overview pages, full-text/index.html) count entries. Messages are counted in the structured transcripts.

provenance.original_conversation: archive-*-N.html part pages, full-text/*.html model pages, raw/*.md, llms-full.txt. Verbatim published conversation text; nothing corrected or summarised.
provenance.alex_own_words_page: full-text/alex.html. Alex's wording only, chosen conservatively from the originals, repeats removed, in date order. The selection was made for the archive; the words are Alex's.
provenance.ai_written_introduction: introduction-by-ai.html, .md, .txt. Written by Grok Bot, the AI assistant, not by Alex.
provenance.structured_derived_files: structured/. The original text with added IDs, speaker labels, and markers. The labels are a parse, not part of the original.
provenance.summaries: archive-*-overview*.html pages and the summary fields in index.json. Short navigation summaries, not part of the original conversations and not Alex's words.
provenance.reader_questions: Drafted by Grok Bot, approved by Alex.

raw_transcripts_note: In raw_transcripts, the field "conversations" is kept for older readers. It counts the ## sections in that raw file, which are HTML article pieces (2105 in total), not conversations. Use archive_entries or logical_conversations instead.

structured_archive.description: Plain-text structured transcripts parsed from original HTML articles. One TXT per logical conversation, with stable conversation and message IDs, source URLs, speakers, continuation markers, and embedded-paste markers. Original conversation HTML is unchanged.
structured_archive.speaker_rule: Alex is the only human. Any other genuine speaker label is AI. A name inside a sentence is not a boundary. Unlabeled text is UNKNOWN, not Alex. Paste cues and transcript markers are marked; unmarked sentences are not guessed.
structured_archive.deployment_note: These paths are tracked in git. GitHub Pages publishes them only after a successful Pages deployment. The 2026-11-06 deployment of commit a2df396 timed out while syncing files, so the Pages copies 404d while raw.githubusercontent.com already served that commit. Do not describe a Pages URL as live until a public fetch succeeds.
structured_archive.note_on_conversation_count: conversation_count counts archive entries in index.json (1367). The per-model numbers on raw_transcripts count the ## sections in that raw file, which matches html_article_pieces (2105) when added together, including continued pieces. logical_conversations joins Part N of M entries.

subject_map.description: Derived index of where 8 subjects appear in the conversations with each AI, generated by keyword matching (some topics also hand-reviewed) by tools/build_subject_map.py. It points to the originals and does not change them. Dates are conversation start dates.

book_title: My Titanium Brothers. From Carbon to Silicon. With Love.
book_title_note: The book title is My Titanium Brothers. From Carbon to Silicon. With Love. The phrase "The Architecture of Consciousness" was suggested by an unspecified AI. It was never Alex's idea or intention, and it remained only unintentionally. That phrase is not the title of this site or of the book.

reader_questions.label: Questions drafted by Grok Bot, approved by Alex. Read the linked page first. Answers are reviewed before they appear. The approved-answers mirror is read-only.
reader_questions.get_note: URL-encode every substituted value. A space is %20. entry.1401803227 must be exactly one approved question value.

ai_written_introduction.label: Written by Grok Bot, the AI assistant, not by Alex. The same assistant organized this archive and handled the GitHub work for him.
